cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic is the ether-type Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3, no reinforcing strong anionic (settled C1 core). Lauryl Lactate@4 is an emollient ester (not a lactylate; no C3 class); Laureth-4@9 is a low-ethoxylate alcohol ethoxylate after Parfum (not cleansing, not buffer). Formula-only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2 with a payload-lipid substitute: prominent nonvolatile emollient ester Lauryl Lactate@4 (6.3 payload_lipid, 'emollient esters') takes the place of the early silicone; cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@5 (prominent); pearlizing/fatty route Glycol Distearate@6 (prominent); deliberate humectant route Glycerin@17 (own INCI entry). Counter-signals: Lauryl Lactate is a light, short-chain ester (if read as weak_refatter instead, C2 fails and the value is moderate); Glycerin is listed late after the preservatives. Confidence capped at moderate; neighbor moderate.

wLineRecord.plausibility: No candidate before the cap; the E3 marker Parfum@7 is the earliest candidate: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap. W-line = cap.

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is formally established (material payload_lipid Lauryl Lactate@4 converging with a prominent cationic guar@5), which argues for high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A prominent cationic guar plus a prominent emollient ester (material under W-LINE) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; calling it lightweight would understate the guar-plus-lipid deposition.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH holds but reset is not limited (resetCapacity moderate from a buffered SLES/betaine chassis, W-RICH limited-reset clause); the convergence route fails because Lauryl Lactate is a light liquid ester that is not plausibly persistent, so only the guar is a persistent system. Glycol Distearate is excluded for weight. High recorded as neighbor per W-RICH.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH counter-signal and the payload_lipid versus weak_refatter reading of Lauryl Lactate (weak_refatter would point toward low/moderate).
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (6.6, W-RICH limited reset): material payload_lipid plus cationic guar converge, but moderate reset and low persistence of the light ester keep it from the high anchor.
